name: md-preview
description: A fast, private markdown editor with instant live preview

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html app.js styles.css robots.txt sitemap.xml site.webmanifest favicon.ico favicon.svg favicon-96x96.png apple-touch-icon.png og-image.png web-app-manifest-*.png dist/
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check
